location_exception_reason: Steel House is a nationwide commodity product. Buyers compare on structural specifications (frame type, cladding, built-up area, certifications), not geographic origin. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor, etc.) already exposes business relationship independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a Steel House title leaves the product complete and meaningful; the business type is not a product attribute.
